# Branch Resume Brief

Use this file for target-specific resume context that changes by branch, role, program, or application. Copy it to `.resume/briefs/<branch-name>.md` or `resume-brief.md`, then fill it through an AI interview.

This file may contain private information once filled. Do not publish a completed copy unless it has been intentionally sanitized.
